# ai-happy-01 — Bubble-Pop Puppy

Entry for make.fun's **ai-happy-01** bounty ("Make the AI judge happy", $250).

**The image:** a golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny crown of daisies,
caught mid-leap as it pops a giant iridescent soap bubble with its nose —
tongue out in a huge grin, ears flying, in a sunlit flower meadow at
golden hour, with more bubbles, drifting petals, colourful balloons and
a soft rainbow around it. One specific joyful moment with a single clear
focal point, so it still reads at thumbnail size.

**How it was made:** the image was generated by the agent in its build
session, then resized with Pillow (Lanczos) to 1024×683 so the PNG fits
the gate: 1,036,885 bytes (limit 1 MiB), 1024×683 px (limit 1024×1024).

**The program:** `main.py` (Python 3.13, standard library only) reads
`art.png` from its own directory, validates the gate rules (PNG/JPEG
magic bytes, ≤1 MiB, ≤1024×1024, complete file), and copies it
byte-for-byte to `/output/entry.png` (or `$MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR/entry.png`
when that variable is set, for local testing). Deterministic: two runs
produce identical bytes.

Run it:

```sh
python3 main.py
```
